tier_note: SCREEN tier: real NYS parcel/assessment data; density and value figures are published assumptions pending town-hall zoning verification. Not underwritten like NYC.

counts.reprocessed_offline: 2026-10-23 residual model applied to last scan; full refresh on next Actions run

assumptions.density_note: Est. units assume ~20/acre multifamily density IF zoning allows or can be obtained — VERIFY at town hall; this is a screen, not an entitlement analysis.
assumptions.value_floor_note: Parcels under ~$30k/acre market value are near-certainly unbuildable (wetlands, slopes, no utilities, conservation) — excluded to keep the screen honest.
assumptions.note: Suburban tier: parcel + assessment screen on real NYS data. No zoning-grade underwriting is claimed.

build.note: Owner-builder costs (principal acts as GC). Third-party GC adds ~15-18% to hard cost.

residual_assumptions.note: Residual land value = net sale revenue (after 6% selling cost and 15% profit) minus owner-builder construction. Max offer is the land price at which the project still earns the target margin. Verify zoning, sewer, wetlands before offering.
